entries.title: Job 8:1
segments: ¶Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

entries.title: Job 8:2
segments: How long wilt thou speak these [things]? and [how long shall] the words of thy mouth [be like] a strong wind?

words.text: these [things]? and [how long shall] the words

entries.title: Job 8:3
segments: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?

entries.title: Job 8:4
segments: If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression; {for...: Heb. in the hand of their transgression}

words.text: against him, and he have cast them away
; {for...: Heb. in the hand of their transgression}

entries.title: Job 8:5
segments: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;

entries.title: Job 8:6
segments: If thou [wert] pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.

words.text: for thee, and make the habitation

entries.title: Job 8:7
segments: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.

entries.title: Job 8:8
segments: ¶For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:

words.text: , I pray thee, of the former

entries.title: Job 8:9
segments: (For we [are but of] yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth [are] a shadow:) {nothing: Heb. not}

entries.title: Job 8:10
segments: Shall not they teach thee, [and] tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?

entries.title: Job 8:11
segments: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?

entries.title: Job 8:12
segments: Whilst it [is] yet in his greenness, [and] not cut down, it withereth before any [other] herb.

words.text: Whilst it [is] yet in his greenness

entries.title: Job 8:13
segments: So [are] the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite's hope shall perish:

entries.title: Job 8:14
segments: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust [shall be] a spider's web. {web: Heb. house}

entries.title: Job 8:15
segments: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.

words.text: it fast, but it shall not endure

entries.title: Job 8:16
segments: He [is] green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.

entries.title: Job 8:17
segments: His roots are wrapped about the heap, [and] seeth the place of stones.

entries.title: Job 8:18
segments: If he destroy him from his place, then [it] shall deny him, [saying], I have not seen thee.

entries.title: Job 8:19
segments: Behold, this [is] the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.

entries.title: Job 8:20
segments: ¶Behold, God will not cast away a perfect [man], neither will he help the evil doers: {help...: Heb. take the ungodly by the hand} {come: Heb. shall not be}

words.text: : {help...: Heb. take the ungodly by the hand} {come: Heb. shall not be}

entries.title: Job 8:21
segments: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing. {rejoicing: Heb. shouting for joy}

entries.title: Job 8:22
segments: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought. {shall come...: Heb. shall not be}
